description: A React component named DetailsViewer that renders detailed views of objects, including features like collapsible nested objects/arrays, formatted known fields, raw JSON toggle, and copy-to-clipboard functionality. It is designed for displaying structured data in a user-friendly way within a web application.

classes.name: DetailsViewer
classes.description: A React functional component for displaying detailed, structured data with features like collapsible sections, formatted fields, and raw JSON view.

methods.name: safePretty
methods.description: Returns a pretty-printed JSON string of the payload, with fallback to string conversion or error message.

methods.name: toLabel
methods.description: Converts a key to a formatted label using formatLabel utility.

methods.name: isTimestampLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a timestamp field based on regex.

methods.name: isTokenLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a token count field based on regex.

methods.name: isDurationLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a duration or latency field based on regex.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a duration string, handling seconds and milliseconds.

methods.name: isCurrencyKeyLoose
methods.description: Determines if a key name suggests a currency or cost-related field.

methods.name: formatValueByKey
methods.description: Formats a value based on its key, applying special formatting for currency, tokens, timestamps, durations, or numbers.

methods.name: initialCollapsed
methods.description: Determines if a nested section should be collapsed based on depth and collapsedDepth prop.

methods.name: Collapser
methods.description: A subcomponent that renders a collapsible section with toggle button.

methods.name: renderPrimitiveVal
methods.description: Renders a primitive value with appropriate styling and formatting.

methods.name: extractAgentIdentity
methods.description: Extracts agent ID and name from an object, used for rendering agent-related data.

methods.name: renderNode
methods.description: Recursively renders a data node, handling arrays, objects, and primitives, with support for collapsible sections and agent-specific rendering.

methods.name: renderEntries
methods.description: Renders object entries as a list with labels and values, ordering highlighted keys first.
